metadata.name: blind_vault
metadata.description: Blind Vault — Storage Wars on Solana with MagicBlock PER + VRF

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Buyer signs CloseEphemeralPermission (ACL member).

instructions.name: close_peek_keeper
docs: House authority closes a foreign peek after reveal.
Peek ACL lists the vault PDA as AUTHORITY (same pattern as MB-016 bids),
so the buyer does not need to be online — unblocks abandoned close_round.

instructions.name: delegate_vault
docs: Delegate Vault PDA. Client also delegates hints/contents/pool via sibling ixs.

instructions.name: fill_vault
docs: Fill vault using TEE-local entropy mix (Day-1 VRF spike fallback §7.5 / R1).
Production path swaps in ER VRF callback once verified on devnet-tee.

instructions.name: force_abandon_stale
docs: House escape hatch after deadline + grace when private bids block `end_auction`.
Marks the lot abandoned and treats bids/peeks as closed so settlement can finish
and a new Open lot can start (Devnet faucet SCRIP — not real funds).

instructions.name: force_clear_active
docs: Clear `house.active_vault` so a new lot can open when the prior round is stuck
mid-settlement on TEE (Devnet/demo escape hatch).

instructions.name: init_contents_permission
docs: Create contents permission only (isolates pool ghost failures).

instructions.name: init_pool_permission
docs: Create pool permission with the house PDA as standing member so later
rounds can Update without the previous vault still being on the TEE.

instructions.name: init_vault_escrow_eata
docs: Create (+ optionally delegate) the vault SCRIP eATA after `create_vault`.

accounts.name: lot
docs: Auction vault PDA (must NOT be named `vault` — macro reserves that for Magic rent vault)

accounts.name: bidder_scrip
docs: Bidder SCRIP ATA (canonical ATA on TEE after delegateSpl). Funds locked via approve.

accounts.name: bidder
docs: Bidder signs CloseEphemeralPermission (ACL member).

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Vault escrow ATA

accounts.name: bidder_scrip
docs: Bidder SCRIP ATA

instructions.name: release_pool_items
docs: TEE-only: mark pool items sold / clear reserved after a round already closed
without pool bit updates (pool stays delegated — MB-015 lifecycle).

accounts.name: closer
docs: Winner signs CloseEphemeralPermission (bid ACL member per MB-016).

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Winner SCRIP ATA (bid.escrow) — vault is SPL delegate from place_bid

instructions.name: touch_account
docs: No-op that forces the TEE to clone a delegated account (e.g. pool after re-delegate).
